say:1:1224301001:1.text: What a coincidence! I was just about to send Bella to you.
say:1:1224301001:1.source_cn: 够巧的，我正准备让贝拉去找你。
say:1:1224301001:1.male: What a coincidence! I was just about to send Bella to you.
say:1:1224301001:1.female: What a coincidence! I was just about to send Bella to you.

say:3:1224301002:0.text: Heh, we've been checking on the docks every day. Looks like the repairs will be done today!
say:3:1224301002:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我们一直算着修码头的时间呢，已经猜到今天差不多要...

say:4:1224301003:1.text: You're right—we're indeed wrapping things up.
say:4:1224301003:1.source_cn: 不错，码头那边已经在收尾了。

say:6:1224301004:0.text: We're getting the ships repaired next, and we need the help of professionals. That frivolous kid and his nannies are experts in this.
say:6:1224301004:0.source_cn: 接下来的问题就是船只，得有专人维护它们。在这方面，那个...

choice_prompt:7:1224301004.text: We're getting the ships repaired next, and we need the help of professionals. That frivolous kid and his nannies are experts in this.
choice_prompt:7:1224301004.source_cn: 接下来的问题就是船只，得有专人维护它们。在这方面，那个轻浮小子和他的妈妈们是熟手。

say:11:1224301007:1.text: There are few shipwrights left in Rustport as many have been hired by the caravans. The villagers of Brineville are the only people who can help us.
say:11:1224301007:1.source_cn: 锈锚港的船匠有限，很多还被商队请去修船了。能帮上我们的...
say:11:1224301007:1.male: There are few shipwrights left in Rustport as many have been hired by the caravans. The villagers of Brineville are the only people who can help us.
say:11:1224301007:1.female: There are few shipwrights left in Rustport as many have been hired by the caravans. The villagers of Brineville are the only people who can help us.

say:12:1224301008:1.text: Yet, it isn't a good idea for us to visit them. They hate us, after all.
say:12:1224301008:1.source_cn: 但是，血薇帮不方便直接去小水村。她们讨厌我们。
say:12:1224301008:1.male: Yet, it isn't a good idea for us to visit them. They hate us, after all.
say:12:1224301008:1.female: Yet, it isn't a good idea for us to visit them. They hate us, after all.

say:17:1224301011:0.text: We will before Tesio's trial, but maybe not afterward.
say:17:1224301011:0.source_cn: 在审判泰西欧之前，一定会。审判之后，或许不会。

say:19:1224301014:1.text: I'm counting on you this time.
say:19:1224301014:1.source_cn: 情况特殊，只能请你们跑一趟了。
say:19:1224301014:1.male: I'm counting on you this time.
say:19:1224301014:1.female: I'm counting on you this time.

say:24:1224301018:1.text: I don't think it's the right time.

say:25:1224301019:1.text: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> manages to get the ladies here, I have to face them sooner or later.
say:25:1224301019:1.male: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> manages to get the ladies here, I have to face them sooner or later.
say:25:1224301019:1.female: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> manages to get the ladies here, I have to face them sooner or later.

say:30:1224301022:1.text: It's just something about my past. You'll find out when the time comes.
say:30:1224301022:1.source_cn: 没什么，一些过去的故事，等时机到了你就知道了。
say:30:1224301022:1.male: It's just something about my past. You'll find out when the time comes.
say:30:1224301022:1.female: It's just something about my past. You'll find out when the time comes.

say:31:1224301023:1.text: I think we should meet with Sinbad first. At this hour, he's probably fishing on the <style="highlight">island in the lake south of the lumberyard</style>.
say:31:1224301023:1.source_cn: 先去找辛巴达吧。这个时间，他大概还在<style=hi...
say:31:1224301023:1.male: I think we should meet with Sinbad first. At this hour, he's probably fishing on the <style="highlight">island in the lake south of the lumberyard</style>.
say:31:1224301023:1.female: I think we should meet with Sinbad first. At this hour, he's probably fishing on the <style="highlight">island in the lake south of the lumberyard</style>.

say:33:1224301024:1.text: How come you know him so well?
say:33:1224301024:1.source_cn: 咦，你怎么知道得这么清楚？

say:34:1224301025:1.text: ...I just know, okay? Stop with the questions already.

say:36:1224301026:0.text: Chippy's got it—Bella and Sinbad know each other!
say:36:1224301026:0.source_cn: 满满明白了，贝拉和辛巴达认识！

say:38:1224301027:1.text: They might even be close friends!

choice_prompt:39:1224301027.text: They might even be close friends!

say:40:1224301028:0.text: Ah, Bella's gone. Let's catch up!
say:40:1224301028:0.source_cn: 呀，贝拉走了，我们快跟上！

say:42:1224301012:0.text: I'm sure they'll treat you with respect since you've saved their lives.
say:42:1224301012:0.source_cn: 不会。你是她们的救命恩人，她们讲义气。
say:42:1224301012:0.male: I'm sure they'll treat you with respect since you've saved their lives.
say:42:1224301012:0.female: I'm sure they'll treat you with respect since you've saved their lives.

say:43:1224301013:0.source_cn: 总比不尝试就放弃要好。

say:44:1224301006:0.text: *Cough* I'm talking about those ladies in Brineville.
say:44:1224301006:0.source_cn: ……咳。我是指，小水村的那帮女人。
say:44:1224301006:0.male: *Cough* I'm talking about those ladies in Brineville.
say:44:1224301006:0.female: *Cough* I'm talking about those ladies in Brineville.

choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 你想找小水村的人帮忙？

say:3:1224302002:1.text: Wow, this is quite a surprise! What brings you here?
say:3:1224302002:1.source_cn: 嘿，哪阵风把你吹来的？真稀奇啊。

say:4:1224302003:1.text: Hold on, did you finally ditch that captain uniform?
say:4:1224302003:1.source_cn: 等等，你换衣服了？终于舍得脱下那身船长服了？

say:5:1224302004:1.text: Everyone was watching me when I wore that at the port; that kind of attention was just too much.
say:5:1224302004:1.source_cn: 穿那身在港口太引人注意了，不自在。

say:6:1224302005:1.text: Let me cut to the chase—I need help from the people of Brineville to repair ships.
say:6:1224302005:1.source_cn: 废话少说。我要请小水村的人帮忙修船。

say:7:1224302006:1.text: I see! No wonder you bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> along to do the talking.
say:7:1224302006:1.male: I see! No wonder you bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> along to do the talking.
say:7:1224302006:1.female: I see! No wonder you bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> along to do the talking.

choice_prompt:8:1224302006.text: I see! No wonder you bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> along to do the talking.
choice_prompt:8:1224302006.source_cn: 哦！难怪你们找来了<style=stress><player_name></style>，原来是请<male>他</male><female>她</female>当说客。
choice_prompt:8:1224302006.male: I see! No wonder you bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> along to do the talking.
choice_prompt:8:1224302006.female: I see! No wonder you bring <style="stress"><player_name></style> along to do the talking.

say:9:1224302007:1.source_cn: 你不用说，站在那儿就足够了。

say:10:1224302010:1.text: Now isn't the time to chitchat! Sinbad, I want you to go back Brineville with me.
say:10:1224302010:1.source_cn: 现在不是闲聊的时候！辛巴达，跟我一起回小水村。

say:11:1224302011:1.text: As a dealer of secrets, my time is billable. Are you paying for my company?
say:11:1224302011:1.source_cn: 作为一个情报贩子，我的时间是可以卖钱的。怎么，你要付钱...

say:13:1224302013:1.text: Don't make me say it again—come with me.
say:13:1224302013:1.source_cn: 不要再让我说一遍，跟，我，回，去。

say:14:1224302014:1.text: You can repeat it as many times as you want, but I must catch ten fish today. I only have six now, so <style="highlight">four more to go</style>!
say:14:1224302014:1.source_cn: 说多少遍都一样。我今天得钓够十条鱼回去，现在才只有六条...

say:15:1224302015:1.text: How about you join me in fishing?

say:16:1224302016:0.text: ...Hmph. <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s a fishing expert. Get him to help.
say:16:1224302016:0.male: ...Hmph. <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s a fishing expert. Get him to help.
say:16:1224302016:0.female: ...Hmph. <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s a fishing expert. Get her to help.

say:19:1224302017:1.text: Wait a minute, why does Magister have to help with everything? Don't forget he's an honored guest of yours!
say:19:1224302017:1.source_cn: 等等，怎么什么事都要主人来帮忙啊！主人明明是血薇帮的贵宾！
say:19:1224302017:1.male: Wait a minute, why does Magister have to help with everything? Don't forget he's an honored guest of yours!
say:19:1224302017:1.female: Wait a minute, why does Magister have to help with everything? Don't forget she's an honored guest of yours!

say:22:1224302019:1.text: Hmm... is that the right attitude when asking for someone's help?
say:22:1224302019:1.source_cn: 啊这……拜托人帮忙还能这样吗？

say:25:1224302020:0.text: Haha, please cut Bella some slack. She just doesn't have much luck with fishing!
say:25:1224302020:0.source_cn: 哈哈，你们就放过她吧。贝拉这家伙，钓鱼的运气太臭！
say:25:1224302020:0.male: Haha, please cut Bella some slack. She just doesn't have much luck with fishing!
say:25:1224302020:0.female: Haha, please cut Bella some slack. She just doesn't have much luck with fishing!

choice:21:1:2.text: Is this a request or a threat?
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 我这是被请求还是被威胁了
choice:21:1:2.male: Is this a request or a threat?
choice:21:1:2.female: Is this a request or a threat?

say:27:1224302008:1.text: You don't quite fit the bill, but your two hamsters have real potential.
say:27:1224302008:1.source_cn: 你可不像，那两只耗子倒勉强能算。
say:27:1224302008:1.male: You don't quite fit the bill, but your two hamsters have real potential.
say:27:1224302008:1.female: You don't quite fit the bill, but your two hamsters have real potential.

say:28:1224302009:1.source_cn: 八卦？什么八卦？给我也讲讲！

say:0:1224303001:0.text: We have four fish already! Let's give them to Sinbad and then head over to Brineville together.
say:0:1224303001:0.source_cn: 钓够四条鱼啦，交给辛巴达之后就一起回小水村吧。
say:0:1224303001:0.male: We have four fish already! Let's give them to Sinbad and then head over to Brineville together.
say:0:1224303001:0.female: We have four fish already! Let's give them to Sinbad and then head over to Brineville together.

say:2:1224304001:1.text: Great, I have enough fish now! Let's enjoy a fish feast tonight!
say:2:1224304001:1.source_cn: 挺好，这样鱼就够了！今晚吃鱼宴！

say:4:1224304003:1.text: Bella, if you have something to say, just get it off your chest.
say:4:1224304003:1.source_cn: 贝拉，有话就说，别憋出病。

say:5:1224304004:1.text: As your long-time friend, I have to ask—are you sure you want to go back? Even with everything going on right now?
say:5:1224304004:1.source_cn: 对了，看在我们认识这么多年的份上，多问一句，你真的要去...

say:6:1224304005:1.text: You still like to ramble as always.
say:6:1224304005:1.source_cn: 你的废话还是一如既往的多。

say:7:1224304006:1.text: Well, I'm okay if you have no problem with it.

say:9:1224304007:0.text: Everyone, please follow me to <style="highlight">Brineville</style> then.

say:11:1224304008:0.text: Huh? Is that it? Chippy's still waiting for the juicy part!
say:11:1224304008:0.source_cn: 啊，这就完了吗？满满还等着听八卦呢！

say:12:1224304009:1.text: We'll get to it once we reach the village! Hahaha!
say:12:1224304009:1.source_cn: 八卦，回村就能知道！哈哈哈！

say:4:1224305002:0.source_cn: 辛巴达，你这孩子，这么久才回来一趟。

say:5:1224305003:1.text: The Magister's here too! This lady is...
say:5:1224305003:1.male: The Magister's here too! This lady is...
say:5:1224305003:1.female: The Magister's here too! This lady is...

say:10:1224305005:1.text: Bella... It's really you! I could hardly believe my eyes just now...
say:10:1224305005:1.source_cn: 贝拉……真是你！我还以为是自己认错了……

say:13:1224305006:1.text: You're a Carmine Whisper now. What are you doing here?
say:13:1224305006:1.source_cn: 你一个血薇帮，来小水村做什么？

say:14:1224305007:1.text: We need your help to repair our ships.
say:14:1224305007:1.source_cn: 血薇帮想请你们帮忙，维护出航的船只。

say:15:1224305008:0.text: That's out of the question! Just leave!
say:15:1224305008:0.source_cn: 别浪费口舌了，我告诉你，没门！你走吧！

say:16:1224305009:1.text: We're rebuilding the docks to revive the trading activities in Rustport.
say:16:1224305009:1.source_cn: 血薇帮正在重建码头，目的是恢复锈锚港的贸易货运。

say:17:1224305010:1.text: This is for the common good, so please think it over.
say:17:1224305010:1.source_cn: 这是对大家都好的事，你们应该好好考虑一下。

say:18:1224305011:1.text: Let's bury the hatchet and put our past conflict behind us—
say:18:1224305011:1.source_cn: 以前的事都过去了，你们不要受私人恩怨影响——

say:20:1224305013:0.text: I've said it before—we'll never do anything for the Carmine Whispers!
say:20:1224305013:0.source_cn: 我早就说过，我们绝对不可能帮血薇帮做事！

say:21:1224305014:0.text: Nothing can change our minds, not even Tesio's imprisonment! Just give up already!
say:21:1224305014:0.source_cn: 即使泰西欧被拉下马，即使他被关押、被审判，这件事也不会...

say:25:1224305016:1.text: *Sigh*... Tasha might sound harsh, but she's got a point. You should go back.
say:25:1224305016:1.source_cn: 唉……塔莎的话是难听了点，但理是这个理。你回去吧。

say:30:1224305017:0.text: There's simply no room for negotiation with the villagers!
say:30:1224305017:0.source_cn: 村民们……拒绝得也太干脆了！

say:31:1224305018:1.text: Was it just me, or did something seem off about the way they treated Bella?
say:31:1224305018:1.source_cn: 是我的错觉吗？大家对贝拉的态度好像有点奇怪……

choice_prompt:32:1224305018.text: Was it just me, or did something seem off about the way they treated Bella?
choice_prompt:32:1224305018.source_cn: 是我的错觉吗？大家对贝拉的态度好像有点奇怪……

say:33:1224305019:1.text: Hmm, Sinbad did mention knowing Bella for a long time.
say:33:1224305019:1.source_cn: 唔，辛巴达也说过，他认识贝拉很多年了。

say:34:1224305020:1.text: Chippy bet the villagers and Bella know each other!

say:35:1224305021:1.text: I think they're more than just acquaintances...
say:35:1224305021:1.source_cn: 肯定不仅是认识这么简单啦……

say:42:1224305024:1.text: What if you can play a part in Tesio's upcoming trial?
say:42:1224305024:1.source_cn: 如果以泰西欧的审判作为交换条件呢？

say:44:1224305026:1.text: You can testify in court and provide your statements to prove that Tesio was responsible for the death of Julius' fleet.
say:44:1224305026:1.source_cn: 泰西欧即将被审判，你们可以出庭作证，也可以提前到议事厅...

say:45:1224305027:1.text: I'll have Sonja and Lucca clear the names of Julius and the rest.
say:45:1224305027:1.source_cn: 我也会请老大和二当家做主，给尤里叔叔他们正名。

say:46:1224305028:1.text: In that case, their reputation can be salvaged.
say:46:1224305028:1.source_cn: ……这样的话，尤里叔叔他们就能洗刷冤屈，你们也不会再被骂了。

say:47:1224305029:1.text: Do your words carry enough weight?

say:48:1224305030:1.text: I'm now the assistant of Lucca, the second-in-command of the Carmine Whispers.
say:48:1224305030:1.source_cn: 我已经是二当家卢卡的副手。

say:49:1224305031:1.text: I have to discuss this with the other ladies in the village. You wait here.
say:49:1224305031:1.source_cn: ……我一个人不能做决定，要和村里的姐妹商量一下。你等着吧。

narration:52:1224305033:0.text: The villagers of Brineville hustle together and engage in a long discussion...
narration:52:1224305033:0.source_cn: 小水村的村民们聚在一起，商量了很久很久……

choice:32:0:1.text: They seemed to know her well.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 她们似乎和贝拉很熟悉
choice:32:0:1.male: They seemed to know her well.
choice:32:0:1.female: They seemed to know her well.

choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 她们憎恶血薇帮，却没有把贝拉赶走

say:0:1224306001:0.text: Seems like the villagers have made up their minds! Let's approach them!
say:0:1224306001:0.source_cn: 村民们似乎讨论出结果了！我们去问问看吧~
say:0:1224306001:0.male: Seems like the villagers have made up their minds! Let's approach them!
say:0:1224306001:0.female: Seems like the villagers have made up their minds! Let's approach them!

say:2:1224307001:1.text: Sinbad, how did the discussion go? Yay or nay?
say:2:1224307001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你们讨论的结果怎么样？答应了吗？

say:3:1224307002:1.text: It's a yay. Bella's offer is irresistible to the villagers.
say:3:1224307002:1.source_cn: 当然。对村里人来说，贝拉开的条件很难拒绝。

say:4:1224307003:1.text: But it comes with a condition—they're only willing to help after Tesio's trial is over, and it'll only be a one-time thing. As for long-term collaboration, that's a matter for another day.
say:4:1224307003:1.source_cn: 不过有条件。必须要等对泰西欧的审判结束后，她们才愿意帮...

say:8:1224307005:1.text: Cool! When do you guys plan to hold the trial?
say:8:1224307005:1.source_cn: 爽快！血薇帮准备什么时候审判泰西欧？

say:9:1224307006:1.text: I'll keep you posted on the date and time.
say:9:1224307006:1.source_cn: 等时间确定了，我会派人通知你。

say:10:1224307007:1.text: The trial will take place at Sanctum Square. It's spacious enough to accommodate the people of Rustport.
say:10:1224307007:1.source_cn: 审判地点定在颂神广场。那儿宽敞，锈锚港的人都能来看。

say:11:1224307008:1.text: Sonja's indeed a woman of her word. She's so much better than that old scum Tesio.
say:11:1224307008:1.source_cn: 不错嘛，索尼娅说话果然算数，比泰西欧那个老混蛋好太多了。

say:12:1224307009:1.text: We won't miss the trial. Remember what you've promised us.
say:12:1224307009:1.source_cn: 放心，我们绝不会错过这场审判。你也别忘了你答应的事。

say:16:1224307012:1.text: Thank you for being here with me, although you didn't do much.
say:16:1224307012:1.source_cn: 今天的事麻烦你了。虽然你没帮上太大的忙。
say:16:1224307012:1.male: Thank you for being here with me, although you didn't do much.
say:16:1224307012:1.female: Thank you for being here with me, although you didn't do much.

choice_prompt:17:1224307012.text: Thank you for being here with me, although you didn't do much.
choice_prompt:17:1224307012.source_cn: 今天的事麻烦你了。虽然你没帮上太大的忙。
choice_prompt:17:1224307012.male: Thank you for being here with me, although you didn't do much.
choice_prompt:17:1224307012.female: Thank you for being here with me, although you didn't do much.

say:18:1224307013:0.text: Being straightforward is good. No one likes to deal with someone as sly as Tesio.
say:18:1224307013:0.source_cn: 直白是好事。没人想和泰西欧那种阴险货色打交道。
say:18:1224307013:0.male: Being straightforward is good. No one likes to deal with someone as sly as Tesio.
say:18:1224307013:0.female: Being straightforward is good. No one likes to deal with someone as sly as Tesio.

say:19:1224307018:1.text: You should get some rest after a long day. I'll report to Lucca by myself.
say:19:1224307018:1.source_cn: 奔波了一天，你们早点休息吧，不必再陪我去向二当家汇报。
say:19:1224307018:1.male: You should get some rest after a long day. I'll report to Lucca by myself.
say:19:1224307018:1.female: You should get some rest after a long day. I'll report to Lucca by myself.

say:20:1224307019:0.text: I'm sure Sonja will call on you to testify at Tesio's trial. See you then.
say:20:1224307019:0.source_cn: 想必审判泰西欧的那天，当家的会请你们过去作证。到时再见吧。
say:20:1224307019:0.male: I'm sure Sonja will call on you to testify at Tesio's trial. See you then.
